verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI355X is a GPU accelerator: hardware plus its ROCm compute stack and cluster-management tooling. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user automations is outside that product category. Nothing in the pack (job scheduler, Kubernetes operator, monitoring tools) shows the product shipping automation versioning or rollback, so the wrong-axis exception does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
